purpose: A11-OUTPUT-1 preregistered semantic mutation validation: MO1-MO12 plus MO4b and MO6b, once each. Harness branch only; NEVER MERGE into product.

contract.section: required_tests.mutations_must_fail_by_assertion: 14 variants plus the final once-each instruction (not a fifteenth variant)

classification.DETECTED: Guards passed (pure: export, recheck and the passing no-mutation control; hosted: restore, install and verify), the trial exited non-zero, and the registered original assertion (named file and line) failed for the registered consequence as the first failure of its test case. The mechanism is recorded separately: 'assertion on the mutated value' (vector, table row, request list, readback, page pixels) or 'original print-status expectation observing the product's own fail-closed refusal', with the exact refusal text.
classification.NOT_DETECTED_AS_REGISTERED: The trial failed, but not at the registered assertion for the registered consequence: a different first assertion, a different refusal text, a thrown product or helper Error without an assertion (a generic input error), a timeout or any unregistered failure.
classification.SURVIVED: Every original test of the trial passed (exit 0) with guards passing.
classification.NOT_DETECTABLE_PER_CONTRACT: MO10 only: the Raysum print got past the average patch before any private render (the texture was ready), so MO10 is not detectable and NOT counted, whatever later order-trace assertion fails.
classification.HELD_TRANSPORT_INCIDENT: The registered failure occurred in a hosted test case that also printed a MIP_OUTPUT_TRANSPORT_FAILURE line; not credited here, left for independent review with the incident.
classification.INVALID: Any guard, anchor, patch, syntax, import, recorder, export, environment or setup-phase failure (results.json phase other than test_volume_mip_output non-zero), or a failing status that is a transport text ('Failed to fetch', 'network error'); never credited, never re-run in this assignment.

transport_policy: Every MIP_OUTPUT_TRANSPORT_FAILURE line in any retained log of a hosted trial is counted and reported as an infrastructure incident beside the result (verify records them per log). No trial is credited from an infrastructure failure. The existing guard (at most one re-attempt per row and three per case) and every row timing, cap and budget stay unchanged. A recurrence across hosted runs calls for a targeted infrastructure correction outside this unit, not fixture retries or tolerance.
